Preparation Instructions

Paneer Butter Masala

  1. Empty contents into a bowl.
  2. Remove oxygen absorber.
  3. Add 167 ml hot water.
  4. Stir thoroughly and cover for 7 minutes.
  5. Mix well and serve hot.
